requirements.summary: For every ControlOperation variant, each producer dominates its consumer, every noninitial phase is covered, replay and fork capability publication follows child checkpoint, and an independent graph seal rejects coupled graph/dependency reversal. Validate normal-result stop handoff, capability lease expiry, external pre-start authority and settlement dominance. Probe recoverable timeout source Attempt completion and fresh Analysis preparation at every publication boundary; reject skipped lifecycle, artifact, checkpoint, preparation and execution fences. Verify consumption-release-to-END producer/consumer closure, reason/target authorization and closed JSON object layouts; reject non-finite numbers and unknown fields. Verify every post-claim failure entry and the consumer-stop/Run-authority closure matrix with semantic probes independent of schema seals.
